Section heading: Talk about the book

keywords.def: the words written for a web page

questions.q: Write a key-point-first line for a page for new pupils
questions.a: For example: Joining TGA online is simple: here are four steps to your first lesson.
For example: Before your first lesson

questions.q: Write two bullet points for that section
questions.a: For example: • test your camera and microphone • log in five minutes early

questions.q: Core: draft the copy for one page (150 to 200 words) with a heading, key point first, two or three sections and bullet points; type it and spell check it
questions.a: A typed, checked web page draft

questions.q: Extend: tick the rules table for your draft
Stretch: suggest one link and write its link text (not "click here")
questions.a: For example: Read our online safety guide

questions.q: Which is the best opening line for a web page about reading at home?
options: This page is a page about reading.
Twenty minutes of reading a day makes a big difference.
questions.a: B) Twenty minutes of reading a day makes a big difference.. B gives the key point at once. A repeats itself; C says nothing.
B) tells you where the link goes
options: tells you where the link goes
